events.name: 2026 ISSMA Marching Band State Finals
events.info: The 2026 ISSMA Marching Band State Finals will feature the "Top 10" Indiana High School Open Class Marching Bands in each of four classes (A, B, C, D) and will also include exhibition performances by the Indiana Scholastic Class A and B State Champion prior to the start of Open Class competition. venues.name: Old National Centre

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office is open on Fridays from noon - 6:00 pm and 2 hours prior to any event.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express, and Cash. No checks.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: WHEN: 2 hours prior to showtime WHERE: Will Call window - West side of building Customers must have actual credit card used to purchase the tickets, a photo ID and their Ticketmaster confirmation/order number.

venues.parkingDetail: Premier Parking is available at all points of purchase. The Old National Centre parking lot is available first come, first serve. Ample parking is also available along streets as well as adjacent parking lots.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible Seating is available for purchase at the Box Office and all Ticketmaster points of purchase.

generalInfo.generalRule: CAMERA POLICY: Personal cameras are allowed in the venue. Flash photography, video and removable lens cameras are NOT permitted without venue approval. RULES/REGULATIONS: Non-Smoking Facility. No Smoking is permitted in the venue. NON-PERMITTED ITEMS: Food/beverages from outside sources Posters / signs / banners Weapons of any kind which could include chains, spiked jewelry, & objects that can be used as weapons. Laser pointers Backpacks Umbrellas ONLY permitted for SELECT shows / performances / events. Handouts such as fliers, stickers, cards, or pictures
generalInfo.childRule: The childrens policy varies per event. Please contact venue to confirm policies for specific events. For all Broadway shows everyone regardless of age needs a ticket.
